correctness.rationale: Idempotent images are fixed. Each image-bearing block is a rooted component with fixed-point count s; other nonempty-domain blocks uniquely attach to one root; empty-domain blocks are isolated. The bijective labeled exponential formula yields the stated trivariate generating function for all m,n. The rank-one and near-maximal cases are separately counted. Python exhaustive checks of whole trivariate tables on six pairs and boundary checks on four more agree; experiments are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: Image rank, domain size, and number of image-bearing partition classes are natural simultaneous invariants for idempotents of a studied finite partial transformation monoid. A single universal generating function classifies every joint multiplicity for arbitrary block count/size, including strictly partial maps; the old order and full-map tables do not determine these data. The canonical root/satellite decomposition has structural explanatory value beyond isolated finite counts.
